intro.en: Each requirement and stretch goal of the {bounty} bounty, quoted word for word from [the bounty page]({source}) as read on {readDate} UTC. The counts come from the ok crossings in [`docs/MEASURED.md`]({measured}), made by `scripts/bounty-table.ts`.
intro.ms: Setiap syarat dan stretch goal bounty {bounty}, dipetik perkataan demi perkataan dari [halaman bounty]({source}) seperti dibaca pada {readDate} UTC. Kiraan datang dari lintasan ok dalam [`docs/MEASURED.md`]({measured}), dibuat oleh `scripts/bounty-table.ts`.

headline.en: Measured on mainnet: {crossings} stablecoin crossings that arrived, on {chains} chains ({chainNames}), in {symbols}; both ways on {bothWays}.
headline.ms: Diukur di mainnet: {crossings} lintasan stablecoin yang tiba, di {chains} rantaian ({chainNames}), dalam {symbols}; dua arah di {bothWays}.

rows.quote: Build a project that allows users to bridge or swap stablecoins into & out of BCH

note.en: Send out (PUSD to another chain) and Bring in (another chain to PUSD at a landing address), signed in the user's own wallets.
note.ms: Hantar keluar (PUSD ke rantaian lain) dan Bawa masuk (rantaian lain ke PUSD di alamat pendaratan), ditandatangani dalam dompet pengguna sendiri.

rows.quote: Ie. to be able to convert stablecoins on other chains to BCH stablecoins (eg USDC on ETH into PUSD on BCH)

note.en: Bring in: the stablecoin is sent to a landing address and arrives as PUSD.
note.ms: Bawa masuk: stablecoin dihantar ke alamat pendaratan dan tiba sebagai PUSD.

rows.quote: And vice-versa, BCH stables to other-chain stables (eg PUSD on BCH into USDC on ETH)

note.en: Send out: PUSD is swapped and sent to the user's address on the other chain.
note.ms: Hantar keluar: PUSD ditukar dan dihantar ke alamat pengguna di rantaian lain.

rows.quote: A swap from BCH stables to stables in one other ecosystem is sufficient, but from BCH stables to multiple/any other ecosystems would be even better.
The faster, cheaper, and easier to use the bridge is - the better.

note.en: Every crossing has its seconds and fees measured, and the cost card shows the fees before signing. No comparison with other routes is claimed.
note.ms: Setiap lintasan diukur saat dan yurannya, dan kad kos memaparkan yuran sebelum tandatangan. Tiada perbandingan dengan laluan lain didakwa.

rows.quote: On the BCH side, WizardConnect is highly recommended.
On the other chain side, WalletConnect is probably essential - but it depends on the paired chains and what is popular/easiest for their wallet integration stack.

note.en: Browser wallets (EIP-6963) signed the measured crossings. A WalletConnect option is in the code; it is not counted here until it is checked on the live site.
note.ms: Dompet pelayar (EIP-6963) menandatangani lintasan yang diukur. Pilihan WalletConnect ada dalam kod; ia tidak dikira di sini sehingga disemak di laman hidup.

rows.quote: Project only needs to support 1 BCH stablecoin, but supporting multiple would be better

note.en: BCH stablecoins with an ok crossing: {bchStables}. The MUSD pools are measured; MUSD stays off until its swaps are measured.
note.ms: Stablecoin BCH dengan lintasan ok: {bchStables}. Kolam MUSD sudah diukur; MUSD kekal mati sehingga tukarannya diukur.

rows.quote: Contacting influential members of other ecosystems that would be willing to facilitate and promote the bridge for users of the other side of the bridge is a laudable business win.
Especially good would be integration or collaborations that route through large popular and existing multicoin providers like ShapeShift, ThorChain etc.

note.en: {thorchain} of the {crossings} crossings route through THORChain, using quotes from its public THORNode API. No collaboration is claimed.
note.ms: {thorchain} daripada {crossings} lintasan melalui THORChain, menggunakan sebut harga dari API THORNode awamnya. Tiada kerjasama didakwa.

rows.quote: ParyonUSD is sponsoring BLAZE this year, so they are an excellent choice for first priority integration & demo purposes.

note.en: PUSD (ParyonUSD) is the default token and the BCH stablecoin of {pusd} of the {crossings} crossings.
note.ms: PUSD (ParyonUSD) ialah token lalai dan stablecoin BCH bagi {pusd} daripada {crossings} lintasan.
